title: 第148章 我只是一个黄毛丫头第147章 亲眼见证夏以苜的能力
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
邱予此刻就像是有蚂蚁在他心上爬一样，迫切地想要知道夏以苜和华长老他们如今研究的方向。
夏以苜只盯着邱予，眼中含笑。
“太上长老之前不是说，要停止种子计划目前的研究方向，让种子计划回到正轨吗？我觉得也确实该如此。”
她眨了眨眼，“太上长老出关了，种子计划自然该由太上长老来带领。”
“华长老，诸位长老，你们应该将自身能力用在正途上，而不是陪我一个黄毛丫头胡闹。”夏以苜又看向华长老等人。
华长老他们一听，瞬间慌了。
之前听说龙瑶木无用时，他们都没有此刻这么慌张。
他们想说夏以苜不是在胡闹，他们就想跟着她做研究。
可估计这邱予还在这里，严格意义上来说，邱予才是他们的头，由邱予来带领他们是理所应当。
若是他们当真这么说了，恐怕下一刻邱予便要暴走，非要拉着他们批评个三日三夜不可。
所以顾及着邱予的脸面，他们没有开口。
但齐刷刷转头，用幽怨的目光看着邱予，试图唤醒他的良知。
邱予在沁阳宗向来是受尽尊重，尤其是在那些弟子面前，更是崇敬无比。
哪怕他也有错，他之前那番话也已经算是认错。
一般弟子见状早就顺着这个台阶下了，邱予还是头一次遇到这般非要计较到底的弟子。
他顿时黑了脸，张着嘴半晌说不出一句话。
憋了半天才道：“你什么意思？”
“我的意思已经表达得很清楚了啊，太上长老。”夏以苜装作听不明白。
“没办法，我只是一个黄毛丫头，哪怕我能提高灵植对魔气的抵抗性，哪怕我能发现云冥花净化魔气的功能，可我也只是一个黄毛丫头。”
她摊手耸肩，表情故作无奈。

“如此重任还是由太上长老来承担吧，太上长老这般岁数，走过的桥比我走过的路还多，自是经验老到，只凭一双慧眼，便能判断是非。”
她说得认真，邱予嘴角止不住地抽抽，他很好奇，夏以苜是如何能将如此阴阳怪气的话说得这么一本正经的。
这是拐着弯地说他武断，还在提他检验她能力的事情。
这丫头未免有些太记仇了。
关键是，她严格意义上来说不算是沁阳宗的人，这样一个自由人更没有能束缚她的东西。
根本不会看在他是太上长老的面子上轻轻揭过此事，更不怕得罪了他。
整个人就处于一种无法选中的状态。
而且，就算夏以苜真是沁阳宗的人，就她那逆天的能力，他们二人对上，沁阳宗还真不一定会选择维护谁。
邱予心中猛然一惊，有种自己这么多年白活了的感觉，到头来竟然还比不过一个小丫头。
恐怕今日不正式和这丫头道歉，这丫头怕是真的要单干了。
邱予一边听着夏以苜几乎明示的话，一边忍受着华长老他们愈发幽怨的目光，心中游移不定。
“至于什么魔气抵抗性和什么净化魔气，还是由我自己来研究吧，便不浪费种子计划的人力资源了。”夏以苜轻叹一声。
到这里，邱予还没有下定决心，觉得夏以苜应该不会离开得这么干脆。
因为一点。
“你可要想好了，若是离开了种子计划，你只有一个人，那样庞大的研究，你一个人如何忙得过来？耽误研究进度想来也不是你想看到的。”邱予板着一张脸。
content_en:
Qiu Yu felt as if there were ants crawling on his heart at this moment, eager to know the direction of Xia Yimo and Elder Hua's current research.
Xia Yishuo only stared at Qiu Yu, with a smile in his eyes.
"Didn't the Supreme Elder say before that we should stop the current research direction of the Seed Project and get the Seed Project back on track? I think this is indeed the case."
She blinked and said, "The Supreme Elder is out of seclusion, so the Seed Project should naturally be led by the Supreme Elder."
"Elder Hua, elders, you should use your abilities on the right path instead of messing around with me, a yellow-haired girl." Xia Yihuo looked at Elder Hua and others again.
When Elder Hua and the others heard this, they immediately panicked.
When they heard that Long Yao Mu was useless before, they were not as panicked as they were now.
They wanted to say that Xia Yihuo was not fooling around, and they wanted to follow her to do research.
But it is estimated that Qiu Yu is still here. Strictly speaking, Qiu Yu is their leader, and it is natural for Qiu Yu to lead them.
If they really said that, I'm afraid Qiu Yu would go berserk the next moment and have to drag them to criticize him for three days and three nights.
Therefore, they did not speak out of concern for Qiu Yu's face.
But Qiu Yu turned around and looked at Qiu Yu with resentful eyes, trying to awaken his conscience.
Qiu Yu has always been respected in Qinyang Sect, especially in front of those disciples, he is even more respected.
Even if he was wrong, his previous words were already an admission of error.
Most disciples would have already walked down the stairs upon seeing this. This was the first time Qiu Yu encountered such a disciple who insisted on fighting to the end.
His face suddenly darkened, and he opened his mouth for a long time, unable to say a word.
After holding it in for a long time, he said, "What do you mean?"
"My meaning has been made very clear, Supreme Elder." Xia Yilu pretended not to understand.
"No way, I'm just a yellow-haired girl. Even if I can improve the spirit plant's resistance to demonic energy, even if I can discover the ability of Yunminghua to purify demonic energy, I'm just a yellow-haired girl."
She spread her hands and shrugged, her expression pretending to be helpless.
"Such an important responsibility should be shouldered by the Supreme Elder. At his age, the Supreme Elder has walked on more bridges than I have walked. He is naturally experienced and can judge right from wrong with just a pair of discerning eyes."
She said it seriously, and Qiu Yu's mouth couldn't stop twitching. He was curious about how Xia Yilu could say such sinister words in such a serious manner.
This is a roundabout way of saying that he is arbitrary, and also mentions that he tested her ability.
This girl is a little too vindictive.
The key is that, strictly speaking, she is not a member of the Qinyang Sect, and such a free person has nothing to restrain her.
There was no way he would reveal the matter lightly because he was the supreme elder, let alone offend him.
The whole person is in a state of being unable to choose.
Moreover, even if Xia Yihuo is really a member of the Qinyang Sect, given her incredible ability, if the two of them face off, the Qinyang Sect will not necessarily choose who to defend.
Qiu Yu was suddenly shocked, feeling that he had lived in vain for so many years, and in the end he was still no better than a little girl.
I'm afraid if I don't formally apologize to this girl today, I'm afraid this girl will really go it alone.
While listening to Xia Yishu's almost explicit words, Qiu Yu endured the increasingly resentful looks from Elder Hua and others, and his heart was wandering.
"As for the resistance to demonic energy and the purification of demonic energy, let me study it myself, so as not to waste the human resources of the Seed Project." Xia Yilu sighed lightly.
At this point, Qiu Yu hadn't made up his mind yet and felt that Xia Yihuo would not leave so simply.
Because of one thing.
"You have to think carefully. If you leave the Seed Project and you are alone, how can you handle such a huge research by yourself? Delaying the progress of the research is not what you want to see." Qiu Yu said with a straight face.
